status: Exploratory new acquisition and identification analysis, frozen before inspecting new host posterior chains or fitting their brightness associations.
scientific_question: Can public observed joint host age/dust/SFH measurements identify selected-supernova residual luminosity evolution B(z), separately from a within-redshift environmental association?
observational_sources: existing pinned unblinded Pantheon+ and DES distance releases
existing raw SDSS host spectral observables
model_source_audit: CIGaRS I code/data must be classified as observed or simulated before any inference; simulated posterior samples cannot substitute for observations.

association.identifier: Exact normalized IAU supernova name first; retain source names. Any positional fallback requires unique SN match within1arcsec and compatible spectroscopic redshift. Host associations remain probabilistic.
association.spectroscopic_type: normal Ia; subtype restrictions retained explicitly
association.measurement_selection: No new photometric detection threshold; preserve signed fluxes, errors, masks and missing bands.

likelihood_policy: Retain joint posterior draws and original priors. Never multiply a posterior as an independent likelihood; any recycling requires explicit prior division, support and effective-sample-size checks. Unknown joint measurement covariance and sample selection are explicit limitations.
cosmology_interface: Host-only data can enter once with linked supernova IDs. Brightness constraints estimated from objects already in a cosmology distance vector cannot become an independent external prior. Supply joint design/likelihood terms or a disjoint sample with declared overlap.
identification: Fit separate within-bin host association and between-bin residual luminosity. A free grey B(z) is exactly degenerate with the SN luminosity-distance relation without external restrictions; quantify null directions and conditional profiles using real observed designs. Host age is not progenitor delay.
output: Reproducible acquisition, observation/chain interface and overlap ledger, numerical identification/profile checks, explicit supported and unsupported likelihood operations. No asserted empirical cosmological correction without selection and transport identification.
